rules.title: San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance (affordable housing)
rules.requirement: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with an arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions. The page gives no details on what is restricted.
rules.requirement_es: La Ordenanza de Oportunidad Justa de San Francisco protege a los residentes con antecedentes de arresto o condena en las decisiones de vivienda asequible. La página no detalla qué se restringe.
rules.quoted_span: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions.
rules.coverage_conditions: Affordable housing decisions only, as described in the source.
rules.caveat: Passing mention only, in a link blurb on an agency homepage. The citation is inferred and not stated in the document. Details, scope and effective date are not provided.
